description: (Na)₂NaInBr₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaInBr₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaInBr₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.86 Å. In is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form InBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-Br bond lengths are 2.69 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one In atom.
